caseName: Household Finance Corp. v. Director of Division of Taxation, Department of Treasury of New Jersey
caseNameFull: Household Finance Corp. v. Director of the Division of Taxation, Department of the Treasury of New Jersey
attorneys: Roger C. Ward for appellant., Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Alan B. Handler, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Goldberg took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
